title: Meet the sound /m/
goal: Practise /m/ and use it in a short, understandable exchange.
cue: Close both lips gently. Let your voice hum through your nose. Feel a gentle vibration. Open into the next sound; do not add an extra “uh” after a final m.
spelling: The letter m usually represents /m/. The letter name “em” is not the same as the sound /m/.
